parsed.post: New personal best (1.034680) achieved by refining the MATRIX_LR to 0.03. The monotone trend of lower LR improving convergence holds. Since 0.03 is showing promise, I'll probe even lower to 0.02 to see if we can find a better local minimum within the budget.
parsed.description: Probing lower MATRIX_LR (0.02) to follow the observed monotone convergence trend of lowering the learning rate.
